selector.rationale: Positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold and persistent distal ileitis despite antibiotic treatment support intestinal tuberculosis, while Crohn's disease is also a strong consideration due to the presence of distal ileal stricture, cecal ulcers, and patchy loss of vascularity throughout the colon.
